rules.description: Employee-side output: no employer payroll tax, FUTA or employer unemployment-insurance tax.
Mandatory amounts only: no amount that rests on an employer's optional election to pass a premium through to wages.
The ACA Premium Tax Credit is excluded.
Local income and payroll taxes are excluded.
A state individual income tax amount: no city or county income tax or credit.
Before refundable credits: no refundable credit is subtracted.
After nonrefundable credits: a tax computed before credits needs its nonrefundable credits subtracted.
A household amount: every member's income the output would count, including a dependent's own return.

run.household_prompt_phrase: Provide the following policy quantities for this household

household_scope_method.filing_requirement: tax_unit_is_required_to_file on the member's own return (policyengine_us/variables/gov/irs/tax_unit_is_required_to_file.py, IRC 6012(a)(1)): gross income above the standard deduction plus the exemption amount (0 while suspended), or unearned income above 500 plus the additional standard deduction
household_scope_method.income_inputs_zeroed_from: gov.irs.gross_income.sources, gov.household.market_income_sources, earned_income and their sums, plus employment_income
household_scope_method.own_return: the member alone as head of a tax unit with claimed_as_dependent_on_another_return = true

law_classification.test: Who owes the contribution under the statute. mandatory_employee_withholding: the statute puts the contribution on the worker and requires the employer to withhold it. optional_employer_pass_through: the statute makes the premium the employer's, and lets the employer deduct up to a share from wages without requiring it, so the employee amount runs from zero to the cap at the employer's choice.
